incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: billing-metering — token_count_drift ALERT (severity: P2). Observed spike in token delta vs canonical counter. Auto-run: fingerprint-check, smoothed-emit reconciliation.

mike.k: acked. I’m oncall, joining now. any customer-facing alerts firing? @billing-ops

billing-ops: got two customers with overage flags in last 10m. Notifications queued but not sent yet (we buffered after previous false positives).

sara.p: good we buffered. quick ask: is this a GC/aggregation lag or a miscount at ingress?

kevin.l: initial diff looks like counts from proxy-ingest were ~2x for short requests where kv-ttl expired early. running a quick query:

kevin.l: ```sql
-- per-customer token ingest vs canonical
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens_ingested) as ingest, sum(tokens_canonical) as canonical
FROM metering.windowed_counts
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY (ingest - canonical) desc
LIMIT 5;
```

kevin.l: result: customer_a ingest 1,205,432 canonical 603,211; customer_b similar pattern.

mike.k: that looks like a doubling upstream. Could be duplicate emitter writes or retry storm. Any recent deploys to emitter-service? @eng-oncall

eng-oncall: no deploys in the last hour. We saw a brief spike in emitter retry rate at 1756054200 correlated with a downstream timeout. Logs show a handful of `EmitterRetry` events.

dave.s: digging into logs, I see the emitter client retried idempotently but without idempotency keys for small requests. So duplicates were recorded as new tokens. patch in progress to ensure idempotency key for short payloads.

sara.p: mitigation plan? do we rollback anything or patch live?

mike.k: immediate mitigations:
- 1) pause outbound overage notifications (billing-ops) — avoid false customer alerts
- 2) enable shadow-reconciliation to prefer canonical count over ingest for flags
- 3) throttle emitter retry backlog by setting circuit-breaker ON for 5m

billing-ops: pausing notifications now (:white_check_mark:). We'll hold outbound notification batch that runs every 2m.

kevin.l: spun up a reconciliation job to re-process 15m window using canonical stream, and will write corrected aggregates to a reconciliation table. ETA ~7m.

anne-ux: are customers already billed incorrectly? any invoices triggered?

billing-ops: no invoice run yet; billing is daily. only alert flags were queued. no charges committed.

dave.s: quick hotfix deployed to emitter (adds idempotency checks) — version v2.3.1. Watching for duplicate writes to stop in logs.

eng-oncall: post-deploy logs show retries reduced, duplicate write rate down to baseline within 60s. emitter client CPU ramped briefly but steady now.

kevin.l: reconciliation job finished. diff summary:
```
- Total ingest delta: +1,200,000 tokens
- Reconciled duplicates: 1,180,412 tokens
- Remaining unexplained delta: 19,588 tokens
```

mike.k: good. Remaining delta small — probably genuine short bursts. Next steps:
- billing-ops: clear queued overage notifications and mark those affected as false-positive
- eng: follow-up PR to add idempotency keys and add counter-level dedupe in writepath
- infra: add emitter circuit-breaker metric and alert on retry ratio > 5%

billing-ops: cleared notifications and wrote customer note plan for any outreach if needed. No customer messages sent. :relieved:

anne-ux: please keep me posted if we need UX messaging templates. small note: customers on trial tiers might have seen UI flags; we'll coordinate a banner if needed.

mike.k: handing off to SRE for post-incident analysis. escalating to P1 if duplicates re-appear, otherwise closing after postmortem.

sara.p: thanks team. tagging for follow-up: #postmortem, #billing-ops, #eng-runtime. filing brief now.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded: INC-2026-1756054321. Severity: P2. Assigned: eng-runtime (dave.s), billing-ops (billing-ops).
